newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Micron Technology EPS raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Micron Technology EPS raised.

text.p: Bear Stearns raised its 1997 earnings estimate on Micron Technology Inc to $0.97 per share from $0.90 per share and its 1998 earnings estimate to $1.10 per share from $1.00 per share, a source at the firm said.
-- Further details were not immediately available.
-- Micron Technology said on Monday its net income in the third quarter rose to $96.8 million, or $0.44 per share, from $58.2 million or $0.27 per share a year earlier.
-- Its stock was unchanged from Monday's close at 41-3/4.
